package main

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "time"
 ffr "github.com/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit/foundations/quality/fitness-function-registry"
)

type Input struct {
 Profile ffr.Profile `json:"profile"`
 SubjectDigest string `json:"subject_digest"`
 Observations []ffr.Observation `json:"observations"`
 EvaluatedAt time.Time `json:"evaluated_at"`
}
func main() {
 if len(os.Args)!=3 { panic("usage: assess input.json assessment.json") }
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]); if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 var in Input
 if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&in);err!=nil {panic(err)}
 result,err:=ffr.AssessProfile(in.Profile,in.SubjectDigest,in.Observations,in.EvaluatedAt)
 if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 body,err:=json.MarshalIndent(result,"","  ");if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(os.Args[2],append(body,'\n'),0600);err!=nil {panic(err)}
 fmt.Printf("required_status=%s criteria=%d soft_score=%v\n",result.RequiredStatus,len(result.Trace),result.SoftScore)
}
